title: PdfPane gesture zoom s144 — pinch = pane ladder (not page zoom) + ctrl+wheel/trackpad pinch, e2e-pinned, validated lane-side 13/13

trace 1a13629f5c00b479 — 'when we try to zoom using pinching, it zooms the whole website, instead of the pdf page'

root_cause_of_record.link_1_viewport: apps/hub/src/app/layout.tsx exports NO viewport → Next injects the permissive default <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">; verified on the DEPLOYED hub (https://syllabai-hub-v2.vercel.app returned that exact meta on an HTTP 200 route and on a 404 probe alike) — page pinch zoom is PERMITTED
root_cause_of_record.link_2_no_handlers: pdf-pane.tsx zoom surface was toolbar −/+/reset + the +/−/0 keys ONLY; exhaustive scan found zero onTouch/gesture/wheel handlers and zero touch-action in the pane, the client wrapper, globals.css and the viewer route
root_cause_of_record.link_3_default_gestures: the pages scroller (overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain) fell through to browser default multi-touch handling → two fingers over the PDF = whole-page zoom (exactly the operator symptom)

fix_of_record.android_chromium_stop: pages region gets touch-action pan-x pan-y — one-finger scroll stays native, the two-finger pinch is unclaimed and reaches the pointer handlers
fix_of_record.ios_stop: non-passive gesturestart/gesturechange/gestureend preventDefault scoped to the scroller (the only page-pinch stop iOS Safari honors; it ignores touch-action AND viewport meta since iOS 10)
fix_of_record.zoom_engine: uniform pointer-based pinch tracker: two live touch pointers, distance ratio rebased per commit (PINCH_STEP_RATIO 1.2), stepping through the SAME zoomBy path as the toolbar (honest-ceiling clamp + anchor-preserving refreeze apply unchanged)
fix_of_record.ctrl_wheel: non-passive wheel listener on the scroller: ctrl/meta+wheel accumulates normalized deltaY (line ×16 / page ×100) into ladder steps at WHEEL_STEP_PX 100 (one Chrome notch); plain wheel scroll untouched; also covers Mac trackpad pinch (arrives as ctrl+wheel)
fix_of_record.deliberately_not_done: NO site-wide user-scalable=no / maximum-scale=1 — the rest of the hub keeps native zoom (a11y law) and iOS ignores it anyway; viewport meta left at the Next default
fix_of_record.known_v1_tradeoff: on a MIXED pan+pinch gesture the browser may claim the pan and pointercancel the pinch (scroll wins); pinch-in-place commit is the contract — full arbitration would require hand-rolled momentum scrolling

validation.e2e_synthesis_note: chromium CDP only (page.mouse.wheel cannot carry modifiers): Input.dispatchMouseEvent modifiers=2 for ctrl+wheel; Input.dispatchTouchEvent for the two-finger pinch; events aimed INSIDE the scroller's visible box (page holders extend ~1600px below the fold — viewport-past events are dropped, the first test draft failed on exactly that); per-finger pointermove stream modeled as a real touchscreen delivers it
validation.stream_probe: first-hand probe logs (since removed from the branch): wheel lands as [ctrlKey=true, deltaY=-100]; touch lands as pointerdown×2 → pointermove pairs per finger → pointerup×2 with ZERO pointercancel — the pan-x pan-y scroller does not claim the pinch
